claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve and a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee, totaling 540,750 ADA.

Dolos is a lightweight Cardano data node built in Rust that connects directly to the Cardano network, indexes ledger primitives, and exposes multiple query interfaces including Mini-Blockfrost, UTxO-RPC, Mini-Kupo, and an Ouroboros N2C socket.
Dolos has 939 commits, 80 releases, 129 stars, 51 forks, and 27 contributors, and remains fully open-source.
The funded maintainer will provide codebase maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.
Dolos aligns with Intersect Strategic Pillar 2 focus area A.3 for Developer Experience and open-source incentives.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.
Independent oversight will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties, with reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.
TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.

Intersect will administer the funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multisig-style permissions, an external Oversight Committee, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for 12 months of Dolos maintenance by TxPipe, submitted by Intersect, with claimed open-source utility, prior development activity, Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, and smart-contract-based treasury administration.
